title: Pay your bills, new deals with updated LiveSmart app

blocks.text: With the rising cost of everyday essentials, from groceries and transportation to household bills, every peso matters more to Filipino consumers.

This is why mobile services provider Smart Communications, Inc. (Smart) and its value mobile brand TNT are giving subscribers more ways to stretch their budget with the launch of the LiveSmart App, a new app that brings loading, fbill payments, and other everyday transactions together while giving users access to exclusive offers, savings, and deals.

Available for download on Google Play Store and Apple App Store, the LiveSmart App helps subscribers of Smart, TNT, and other network providers to stay one step ahead by bringing more benefits and opportunities to save in one convenient app.

“With the rising cost of everyday expenses, Filipinos are becoming more deliberate about where they spend and how they can get more value from every peso. The LiveSmart App is designed to help make those everyday decisions a little smarter, by giving users convenient ways to load, pay bills, and access exclusive savings and offers in one place,” said Lloyd R. Manaloto, FVP and OIC for Smart.

“As we celebrate our subscribers this September 18, or 9.18, we are also giving them more reasons to experience the LiveSmart App, with exclusive offers and benefits that reward them for choosing Smart and TNT. And this is just the beginning, as we continue to bring more value and opportunities to our subscribers through the app.”
Life made ‘sulit’ with exclusive deals and perks

To celebrate its subscribers, Smart and TNT are rolling out exclusive offers on the LiveSmart App starting Sept. 18, including cashbacks, special Smart and TNT data offers, and FREE access to AI.Smart. Smart and TNT subscribers can enjoy a 5% cashback when they purchase load or pay their Smart Postpaid bill through the LiveSmart App. The LiveSmart App also gives users access to exclusive Smart and TNT offers available only through the app. For example, Smart Prepaid subscribers can get Power All 109 for only P105, while TNT subscribers can enjoy Saya All 109 for only P105.

Users downloading the LiveSmart App may also get limited-time FREE access to AI.Smart, a one-stop AI workspace that brings multiple advanced AI models, including AWS Nova, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, and Thinking Machines, into one easy-to-use experience.

Users simply have to click the AI.Smart banner on the LiveSmart App and simply create their AI.Smart account using their Smart or TNT number to claim their free credits, which they can use to generate images, create presentations, draft documents and spreadsheets, and get assistance with schoolwork, content creation, and other projects.
Beyond these special offers, users can look forward to more exclusive perks and deals from lifestyle partners, as Smart continues to expand the LiveSmart App and bring more value to its users.

Users can make the most of the LiveSmart App powered by Smart 5G, which enables users to enjoy a seamless mobile experience for activities such as video streaming, gaming, and real-time social media sharing.

Smart was recently recognized by global connectivity intelligence leader Ookla® for delivering the Best Mobile Video Experience in the Philippines for the first half of 2026, with a Video Score of 72.82, the highest among mobile operators in the country.
Download the LiveSmart App now from Google Play Store and Apple App Store. To learn more, visit https://smart.com.ph/Pages/livesmartapp.
